display_font.rationale: Strong, authoritative, and slightly technical display font that avoids the standard AI 'SaaS' look. Perfect for confident financial headers.

body_font.rationale: Clear, precise, and objective. Provides high legibility for dense financial data and dashboards.

mono_font.rationale: The gold standard for developer interfaces. Instantly communicates a 'developer-first' API platform.

spacing_scale.rationale: Generous spacing on landing, dense 'Control Room' spacing for dashboard.

landing.hero: Left-aligned highly technical headline (Cabinet Grotesk, text-6xl, tracking-tighter). Right side features abstract 3D floating cards and code. CTA is stark and solid.
landing.features: Dark grid borders exposing the skeleton. High contrast monochrome cards.
landing.developer_section: Terminal/Retro-Futurism aesthetic. Massive code block over dark graphite texture.

login_register.left: Dark, moody abstract background with faint data lines. Brand statement in center.
login_register.right: Solid background. Minimalist form. High-contrast input borders.

dashboard_home.top: North star metric (Gross Volume) in large display font. No card container, just raw numbers and a trend line.
dashboard_home.main: Modular widgets: Revenue Chart (Line), Success Rate (Donut), Recent Activity (List).

transactions_table.structure: Full-width table filling the main content area.
transactions_table.actions: Top bar with search input (left) and filter dropdowns (right).
transactions_table.detail_view: Slide-out drawer (Sheet component from Shadcn) on row click. Contains timeline of the payment intent, raw JSON logs, and 'Refund' action button.

api_keys.structure: Two-column layout or constrained center column.
api_keys.content: Alert banner warning about secret key exposure. Standard key table (Publishable vs Secret). Secret key hidden by default, requires 'Reveal' action.

hosted_checkout.structure: Light card on dark background (or fully light theme override for trust).
hosted_checkout.container: Central constrained card (max-w-md). White background, black text. Soft shadow to pop off the dark void background.
hosted_checkout.form: Apple/Google Pay buttons stacked. Divider. Embedded card input. Pay CTA.

image_urls.description: Dark aesthetic 3D rendering of floating metallic credit cards and code snippets in a void, sharp edge lighting, volt yellow accents
Subtle dark graphite texture with faint glowing data lines

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) are imported via Google Fonts or Fontshare in the index.html or global CSS.
Tailwind configuration must extend the provided color tokens, specifically using the 'accent' (#D4FF00) for primary buttons and interactive states.
Do NOT use generic purple or teal gradients. Stick to the dark fintech aesthetic: rich blacks (#050505), crisp borders (#27272A), and Volt Yellow accents.
For the hosted checkout page, use a distinct layout: a crisp white card on the dark background to build consumer trust, completely contrasting the dark developer dashboard.
Implement 'data-testid' on all interactive elements: forms, buttons, links, toggles.
Use Shadcn UI but heavily customize the card, table, and input primitives to match the component recipes defined here. No default 'Vercel-look'.
Ensure the API keys in the dashboard are hidden by default, utilizing the key_reveal recipe for interactions.
